title: Qt: Don't repeatedly warn about no interfaces with stats
description:
When dumpcap -S exits indicating that there are no interfaces for
which statistics can be collected, don't keep printing that message
to the console. Once is enough.

We do want to keep trying to collect statistics, I reckon, as
unfortunately even on Linux and the BSDs the notification about
interfaces going up or down or going away doesn't tell us when
permissions change.

AI-Assisted: no
